result_summary.title: Payment Gateway errors: Rate limits and empty responses
result_summary.description: In our US-East staging environment, we are seeing a mix of errors when interacting with Payment Gateway v2. We are frequently hitting rate limit exceeded errors, but when we do receive a response, it is often an empty body or malformed JSON. This is occurring during batch transaction tests involving 47 simulated users. The combination of these errors is making it difficult to determine if the issue is our throttling configuration or an instability in the gateway's staging sandbox.
